title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-source provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, and publication evidence.

The P22 cluster formalizes generic regularity, characteristic-zero descent to finite lower-unitriangular coordinate changes, regular division, the internal bounded-part/principal-tail decomposition, the finite free quotient and containing-ideal image associated with a supplied regular polynomial, and the source-facing common-tail quotient isomorphism after equation (23). The last item is explicitly packaging of Mathlib's existing second isomorphism theorem, not new mathematics.

Lean verification certifies only the formal statements and explicit assumptions. It does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
